specs.Item Highlight: Over Ear Wireless Headphones with Microphone, 70+ H Playtime Foldable Bluetooth with Multipoint & Customisable Sound

features: SMART ANC HEADPHONES: Smart Active Noise Cancellation adjusts to the environment and continually learns how to best cancel noises, offering the best audio experience. Activate the Smart Active Noise Cancelling to eliminate external distractions up to 25 dB or switch to Be Aware mode to remain connected to your environment

IMMERSIVE LAB QUALITY SOUND: Active noise-cancelling headphones with exceptional sound quality via 40mm drivers, bringing depth and clarity to your music. Enjoy immersive sound with Spatial Audio, compatible with applications such as Dolby Atmos, Tempest 3D AudioTech and Windows Sonic

LONG BATTERY LIFE & COMFORT: Over-ear headphones that let you enjoy up to 70+ Hours of Bluetooth 5.3 playtime. Turn ANC on and you'll get up to 40+ hours of playtime, so you can enjoy uninterrupted music sessions or calls. The 1” Cloud Foam ergonomically shaped cushions and adjustable hinges further customise your comfort for any travel, gym workout, or work commute

BLUETOOTH MULTIPOINT & EASY CONNECTION: Seamlessly connect to and toggle between two devices simultaneously using Bluetooth Multipoint. Wireless Share Mode allows you to share audio wirelessly between two Lux foldable Bluetooth headphones. Effortless pairing with an Android device with Google Fast Pair. Plus locate your overhead noise cancelling headset with Google Find My Device

CRYSTAL CLEAR CALLS: Furnished with cutting-edge noise-cancelling microphones, these wireless headphones ensure crystal clear and uninterrupted communication during calls, ensuring exceptional clarity and eliminating external disturbances for an impeccable conversation experience
